title: Comparison dg functors for freely contracting a formal cone
statement:
Let $R$ be a commutative ring, $\mathcal A$ a small $R$-linear cochain dg category, and $u:x\to y$ a closed degree-zero arrow. Use the free adjoining constructions of [lem-coef-dgcat-free-cell-calculus] and the labelled cone enlargement of [lem-coef-dgcat-formal-cone-enlargement]. Let $\mathcal L$ be the full subcategory of $\operatorname{Cone}(\mathcal A)$ on the labelled representables and $Z=C_u$. Let $\mathcal T=\mathcal L\langle h:Z\to Z,\ |h|=-1,\ dh=1_Z\rangle$, and let $\mathcal T_0$ be its full subcategory on the representable labels. Identify those labels with the objects of $\mathcal A$. Write $\iota_y,\pi_y,\iota_x,\pi_x$ for the graded cone inclusions and projections of degrees $0,0,-1,1$, respectively, and put
$$v_h=\pi_xh\iota_y,\quad a_h=\pi_xh\iota_x,\quad b_h=-\pi_yh\iota_y,\quad w_h=-\pi_yh\iota_x.$$

Let $\mathcal B$ be obtained from $\mathcal A$, without changing objects, by freely adjoining $v:y\to x$ of degree $0$, $a:x\to x$ and $b:y\to y$ of degree $-1$, and $w:x\to y$ of degree $-2$, with
$$dv=0,\quad da=vu-1_x,\quad db=uv-1_y,\quad dw=ua-bu.$$
There exist dg functors $F:\mathcal B\to\mathcal T_0$ and $G:\mathcal T_0\to\mathcal B$, identity on object labels and on the given $\mathcal A$ coefficients, such that
$$F(v)=v_h,\ F(a)=a_h,\ F(b)=b_h,\ F(w)=w_h,\qquad G(v_h)=v,\ G(a_h)=a,\ G(b_h)=b,\ G(w_h)=w.$$
More precisely, if $j:\mathcal A\to\mathcal B$ is the attaching functor, there is a dg functor $\widetilde G:\mathcal T\to\operatorname{Cone}(\mathcal B)$ whose restriction to $\mathcal L$ is the labelled cone extension of $j$, whose value on $h$ is the endomorphism of $C_{j(u)}$ with matrix
$$\begin{pmatrix}-b&-w\\ v&a\end{pmatrix},$$
and whose restriction on $\mathcal T_0$ is the representable embedding composed with $G$.
